terms-record.predicate: every host and path prefix the feed specification fetches is admitted by a certified record of venue/sources.toml under the feed's source (ingest/terms.py: certified and admits)
terms-record.sample: every fetched URL in the evidence's poll logs

live-first-seen.metric: per observation in the live window, its first-seen time (the receive time of the first poll returning it) minus the declaration's rule time
live-first-seen.threshold: no observation is first seen after its rule time plus the source's tolerance; claimed times count only where protocol-enforced or server-set
live-first-seen.sample: every observation first seen in the window
live-first-seen.window: a continuous live recording of at least 24 h without a clock-log gap over 10 min
evidence: poll logs with send and receive times

recorder-bound.predicate: the rule is bounded below by fetchedAt (its lower-bound set contains field fetchedAt) and every fetchedAt is a recorder's receive time in the authenticated poll logs

lineage-bound.predicate: for every derived row, its recorded lineage resolves at the cutoff to the selected upstream revisions, and its effective knownAt equals the rule's value with every dependency bound applied (RULES.md §6); the verifier recomputes the transformation

refetch-compare.metric: per key, whether a re-fetch of the history at a later time returns the same observed values
refetch-compare.threshold: reported, not judged: the resolver hides every changed value until its fetch (RULES.md §6); the test requires that the re-fetch was made and compared
refetch-compare.sample: every key of the certified scope
refetch-compare.window: a re-fetch at least 24 h after the first

blind-labels.metric: precision of the entity mapping on a blind-labelled sample
blind-labels.threshold: precision >= 0.8 (stage 5's threshold), with each labeler's independence recorded
blind-labels.sample: a uniform random sample of mapped records with a frozen seed

gaps.metric: per entity, the share of expected observations missing and the longest gap, against the declaration's cadence
gaps.threshold: at most 1% missing and no gap over 24 h (stage 0's C0.2), every gap listed; for event cadences, coverage intervals stored as data
gaps.sample: every expected slot of the certified scope
